claim: A-06 target-state: 'One planner pipeline, not three planners: scope → route → constrained LLM synthesis → vidhi validator emitting a PlanReceipt.' The doc frames current reality as 'three planners'.
reality: Static trace of the identical question 'what does my career look like this year' finds FOUR distinct planner surfaces, of which TWO are live-but-structurally-incompatible and TWO are dead islands. (1) LIVE web consult: consult/route.ts:436 calls callPipelinePlanner (imported as runPlanner at route.ts:72; pipeline_planner.ts:269) which does ONE constrained-LLM call and emits a PipelinePlan (query_class + LLM-chosen tool_calls[{tool_name,params,priority,reason}] + asset_bundle); NO floor/machine-band/dark/CR/receipt/capability_version concept. (2) LIVE MCP: server.ts:388 registerVidhiPlanTool → plan_retrieval → buildVidhiPlan (plan_builder.ts:52) emits a VidhiPlan (deterministic floor+machine_band + completeness_receipt served/empty/dark + capability_version). (3) DEAD island: platform/src/lib/retrieval/router/router.ts 'D2 Query Router' route() — imported only by its own test + barrel, zero production importer. (4) DEAD island: platform/src/lib/vidhi/compiler.ts compileContract — zero production importer (a duplicate of the MCP vidhi compiler). So identical input yields a PipelinePlan on web and a VidhiPlan on MCP — two non-interoperating plan objects — while two more planner implementations sit unwired. Reality is worse than 'three planners': four surfaces, two live-divergent.

claim: Does a plan carry 'dark' items with CR refs, and how many for a typical question?
reality: YES, the dark concept is REAL and SHIPPED — on the MCP channel only. A dark item = a compiled floor item whose backing primitive has a non-null known_gap (a CR-N pointer) and was not served; it is emitted in completeness_receipt.ts's dark[] bucket as {floor_item_id, cr_row} with cr_row matching /^CR-\d+$/ and guaranteed OPEN/LOGGED (never CLOSED) via isCitableKnownGap. The receipt invariant: served ∪ empty ∪ dark = the full deduped floor-item set (TOTAL), pairwise DISJOINT. CONCRETE COUNT for the traced question (career_deepdive intent, 12 floor items): exactly 5 are dark at plan issuance, citing CR-56 (dhana_yoga_scan — house-lord yoga detector absent, ELEVATED #1 blocker), CR-64 (nakshatra_semantics), CR-24 (mechanism_read), CR-66 (taranga_curve — Phala domain anchors zero), CR-69 (intervention_synthesis — no leverage_index axis). Registry-wide there are 12 known_gap primitives total (CR-16/24/30/37/56/61/64/66/67/68/69/73) out of 114; a single-intent plan carries only the subset on its floor. NB: this exists ONLY in MCP vidhi; the live web PipelinePlan carries NO dark concept.

claim: FALSIFICATION EXERCISE (PC-3): attempt to sketch the unified plan type the architecture (A-06) calls for — floor+machine-band as one addressable set, per-item served/empty/dark with CR refs, tool+args resolved against capability_version, a decidable subsumption relation — and report honestly whether it is a day, a week, or a genuine contradiction.
reality:
VERDICT: WEEK-SCALE INTEGRATION, NOT A CONTRADICTION — and ~80% of the type ALREADY EXISTS, unrecognized, as the MCP VidhiPlan. NO type-theoretic impossibility was found. FULL REASONING:

Sketch of the unified type U:
  type UnifiedPlan = {
    capability_version: string        // content-hash of registry+compiler
    scope_tuple: {intent, domains, width, depth, horizon, intervention?, entitlement}
    items: PlanItem[]                 // floor ∪ machine_band ∪ llm_extensions, ONE addressable set keyed by a stable item_id
  }
  type PlanItem = {
    item_id: string                   // = primitive_id for floor/band; minted id for llm extensions
    band: 'acharya_floor'|'machine_band'|'llm_extension'
    tool: string                      // resolved live MCP tool name
    args: Record<string,unknown>      // resolved against chart_id (+ capability_version)
    status: 'served'|'empty'|'dark'
    cr_row?: string                   // set iff status==='dark'; /^CR-\d+$/, OPEN/LOGGED
    empty_reason?: string             // set iff status==='empty'
  }
  subsumes(a: UnifiedPlan, b: UnifiedPlan): boolean =
    ∀ i∈b.items where i.band!=='llm_extension' : ∃ j∈a.items with j.item_id===i.item_id  // set-containment over floor/band item_ids

Evidence this is buildable, not contradictory: the MCP path ALREADY realizes almost all of U. VidhiPlan (plan_builder.ts:29) carries capability_version + scope_tuple + floor + machine_band + completeness_receipt; completeness_receipt.ts's uniqueFloorItems() ALREADY collapses floor∪machine_band into ONE deduped addressable set keyed by primitive_id (the 'one addressable set' requirement — DONE); served/empty/dark with cr_row + OPEN/LOGGED CR guarantee is DONE; tool+args are resolved per CompiledFloorItem.live_tool + compileContract(chart_id) (DONE); capability_version is a content-hash with a staleness-kill (capability_version.ts — DONE). A 'subsumes' relation over primitive_id set-containment is trivially decidable because both operands are finite sets of string item_ids.

WHERE THE REAL COST LIVES (the honest week, three concrete gaps, none fatal):
1. NAMESPACE UNIFICATION (the load-bearing one). The subsumption relation A-06 actually needs is 'does the LIVE web plan cover the deterministic floor?' — but the web PipelinePlan keys tool_calls by tool_name = 'one of the tool_names in CAPABILITY_MANIFEST.json' (pipeline_planner.ts, types.ts:108) and its few-shots emit R-alias names (multi_school_signal_lookup, convergence_score_lookup), while VidhiPrimitive keys on live_tool = bare MCP tool names (ganita_chart_facts_get, ...). These are OVERLAPPING-BUT-DISTINCT namespaces. Subsumption is decidable ONLY given a TOTAL map tool_name→primitive_id; today only a replay-oriented tool_name_bridge.ts exists (per C-3, not a planner-floor mapping). Building/verifying that total map is the bulk of the week.
2. LLM BAND-3 IS NOT ADDRESSABLE. Today band-3 is a free-text llm_extension_note on VidhiPlan, not typed items — so 'per-item served/empty/dark' cannot cover LLM-chosen extensions until they are promoted to PlanItems with minted ids. Modest.
3. TWO RUNTIMES. The deterministic vidhi is MCP-only; the live web route runs PipelinePlan with NO floor/receipt/dark/capability_version at all. Unifying = make the web consult route compile+validate against vidhi and emit U — which C-2 independently showed requires touching consult/route.ts (the planner call site route.ts:436 and the dispatch). So the unification is coupled to the same route reorder C-2 priced.

WHY IT IS NOT A CONTRADICTION: the only candidate for a genuine contradiction was 'a deterministic floor cannot contain a non-deterministic LLM plan in one addressable set.' It resolves cleanly: the floor/band items are deterministic and the LLM items are additive-only (band==='llm_extension'), and subsumption is DEFINED to ignore llm_extension items — so determinism of the floor is preserved while the LLM layer is still per-item accountable. No requirement forces the LLM output to be deterministic; A-06 only requires the LLM plan be VALIDATED-as-covering the deterministic floor, which set-containment gives.

HONEST VERDICT: a WEEK (5-8 working days) dominated by gap #1 (total tool_name↔primitive_id map + its CI proof) and gap #3 (wiring the web route through the already-built vidhi compiler + emitting U instead of PipelinePlan). It is NOT a day (the namespace map + route reorder are real), and it is NOT a contradiction (the type closes; MCP already proves ~80% of it runs). The negative-for-contradiction result is itself the high-value finding: the architecture's unified plan type is an INTEGRATION debt (two live divergent planners + two dead islands), not a design impossibility.
